```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Education is more than schooling and includes the transmission of knowledge, skills, ethical norms, behavioral norms, traditions, and cultural identity from families and communities to younger generations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"American education has been the focus of controversy for several decades due to centralizing forces seeking to remake education and, in doing so, remake America.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These centralizing forces have done immense damage to American education.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal government should not be a partner in efforts to remake education, as the Constitution gives it no role in education.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American Experiment is based on the principle that all men are created equal and endowed with unalienable rights, including Life, Liberty, and the Pursuit of Happiness.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The view of the individual as human capital—a possession for the creation of another's wealth—is rejected.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
